verses.text: Haton juntzanh tik alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' ay t'a ch'olan b'aj sch'oxji tas nab'il yuj Jehová, syalan icha tik: ¿Tas tzex ik'ani yuj chi' he masanil tzex k'e t'a yib'anh pat?
Toxonhej tzex k'e somnajok, wek'eq'ui yel eyaw yuj eyak'an q'uinh. Ha heb' anima chamnak t'a he kal, manhok yuj k'een espada chamnak heb', manhok pax t'a skal owal chamnak heb'.
Masanil heb' eyajalil, ol b'at heb' elelal, palta ol yamchaj heb' yik mantzak julwaj heb'. Ha wal heb' soldado te tek'an, najat ol b'atkan heb' elelal, palta ol yamchajnhej heb'.
Yuj chi' swal icha tik: Elanhek t'a in tz'ey, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin ok' wal sik'lab'il. Manh he na tas tzeyutej eyak'an sniwanil in k'ool yuj jantak yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh in chonhab'.

Yujto a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, toxo ix yala' to ol ja wal jun k'ual niwan xiwk'olal, somk'olal yet' yaelal t'a yib'anh lum ch'olan b'aj sch'oxji tas nab'il yuj. Ol mak'jokem lanhnaj smuroal chonhab'. Ol laj tak'wok lum witz yel yaw heb' kajan t'a chonhab' chi'.
Ha heb' aj Elam, wan sb'oan sjul-lab' heb', ayxok'e heb' t'a yol skarruaje, ayxopaxk'e heb' t'a yib'anh schej. Haxo heb' aj Kir, wan yik'anchaanh smaklab' jul-lab' heb'.
Masanil juntzanh lum ch'olkiltak wach' yilji, b'ut'anxo lum yuj karruaje. Haxo heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, wanxo yak'an owal heb' t'a spuertail he chonhab'.
Ha tas yipk'olal yaj yuj Judá, toxo ix sateli. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix eyil juntzanh yamk'ab' yik owal molb'il t'a jun niwan pat skuchan Spatil Te te' yik Líbano.

Eyilnak pax tzijtum spojelal smuroal schonhab' winhaj David. Ix he pojanem juntzanh pat chi' yuj eyak'anoch yipumalok smuroal chi'. Ix eyak'an b'ut'jok jun yet'taltaxon ha ha' b'aj smolchaj t'a yalanh.

Ha t'a skal chab' muro ix he b'o jun yet'tal ha'. Haxo ta' ix b'atkan ha' ay t'a yol jun yet'tal ay t'a pekatax chi'. Palta maj nachajel eyuuj to a Jehová wan yak'ankot juntzanh yaelal chi'. Atax t'a peka' naan yuj, palta malaj jab'ok yelk'och t'a he sat.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tzex awtani yik tzex oq'ui, tzex kusi, tze joxanel xil he jolom, tzeyak'anpaxoch pichul ya swa'i yik tze ch'oxanel he kusk'olal yuj he chukal, palta max yal-laj he k'ool.

Ha tas tze k'ulej to tzeyak' q'uinh t'a tzalajk'olal, tze milancham nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Tzex wa wal, tzeyuk'an anh. Tzeyalan icha tik: Konh waek, kuq'ek anh, kaq'ek ko gana, talaj chamnak onhxo k'ik'an, xe chi.

Haxo Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayin, ix yalan t'ayin: Manh ol wak' niwank'olal jun schukal pensar heb' tik, palta to ol in satel heb', a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala', xchi.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix halan t'ayin: Ixik, b'at il winhaj Sebna yilumal spalakio winh rey, tzalan t'a winh icha tik:
¿Tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? ¿Mach ix ak'an opisio a b'oan jun yet'tal chamnak t'a jun tzalan tik, tzolanpaxoch a b'a t'a sat k'een k'een b'aj ol ach kannhej tik a naani?
Wach'chom niwan elk'och halani, palta a in Jehová in ol ach in julkanb'at t'a najat. Yet' wal jantak wip ol ach in yamani,

ol ach in julkanb'at b'alb'on icha junok tas k'olan k'olan. Te najat ol ach b'atkan t'a jun lum lum te lewan sat. Hata' ol ach chamok, ol satel karruaje tz'ak'an sniwanil elk'och chi'. Tzak' wal q'uixwelal heb' etmunlajwumal t'a spalakio winh a reyal chi'.
Ol ach wik'el t'a opisio tik, ol ach in julankanel b'aj ayach ek' tik.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol wawtejkot winh in chekab' aj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Hilcías.

Ol wak'och a pichul yik opisio chi' t'a winh yet' a kincho yik a b'inajnakil. Ol wak'ankan opisio chi' t'a winh. Icha junok mamab'il ol aj winh t'a skal heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik yet' t'a heb' aj Judá.
Ha t'a yol sk'ab' winh ol wak'och sllaweal spalakio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj David. Malaj mach ol yal smakan puerta ol sjak winh, malaj pax mach ol jakan puerta ol smak winh.
Te wach' ol wutej wak'anoch winh t'a yopisio chi', icha wal tz'aj slawuxajkanoch junok tas t'a sat pat. Ol b'inajkan winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Masanil heb' sk'ab'yok smam winh yet' yinhtilal, niwan ol aj yelk'och heb' yuj winh. Ichato al ol ajkanoch heb' t'a yib'anh winh. Icha tz'ajoch lokan lum chenxalu yet' masanil yamk'ab' yik junok pat t'a junok te' lokte' mak'b'ilochi, icha chi' ol ajoch heb' t'a winh.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a jun te te' wach' yaj smak'chajoch chi', ol elta choknaj te'. Ol emta tanhnaj te' t'a sat lu'um, ol pojkanb'at masanil tas lokanoch chi' t'a te'. Ha wal Jehová tz'alan t'ayin, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
